verdict.rationale: Puzzle documents automations such as custom categorization rules, AI Close agents and AI tasks, so this axis applies. However, no evidence shows that the automations themselves can be versioned, have their definitions reviewed, or be rolled back. Reviewing outputs before they are final, MCP write confirmations, and reversing edits to manual journal entries are adjacent behaviors applied to individual results or transactions, not version control or rollback for automations.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
